nodes.name: App Shell & Router
nodes.plain_english: The root React component that manages navigation between views and holds shared state (current analysis, audit history).

nodes.name: Dashboard View
nodes.plain_english: Overview page showing KPI metrics (total CO2, items tracked, optimization score), Charts (hotspot bar, pie, Sankey), latest audit summary, and recommendations.

nodes.name: Audit View
nodes.plain_english: Upload page where users drop PDF/Excel files for analysis. Shows a supply chain graph (ReactFlow) and a material/energy/transport data table after analysis completes.

nodes.name: Graph View
nodes.plain_english: Full-screen interactive supply chain graph visualization with zoom controls, plus charts below when data exists.

nodes.name: Strategies View
nodes.plain_english: AI chat consultant page. Left panel: real-time conversation with Graph RAG backend. Right panel: AI-generated recommendations cards with scope labels.

nodes.name: Reports View
nodes.plain_english: Historical audit browser. Left: scrollable list of past audits. Right: detailed breakdown with emissions table, scope bars, summary, and export buttons (PDF/CSV).

nodes.name: FastAPI Server
nodes.plain_english: The main backend server that handles all API requests from the frontend.

nodes.name: PDF Analysis Engine
nodes.plain_english: Extracts text from PDFs and Excel files, then uses OpenRouter AI to identify materials, energy use, and transport emissions.

nodes.name: Analytics & Charts
nodes.plain_english: Generates interactive Plotly charts — carbon hotspot bars, emission breakdown pie, and supply chain Sankey diagram.

nodes.name: PDF Report Generator
nodes.plain_english: Creates professional ISO 14067 carbon footprint reports as downloadable PDFs.

nodes.name: Search & Emission Factors
nodes.plain_english: Looks up verified emission factors from a trusted database and searches Serper.dev for unknown materials.

nodes.name: Graph RAG Chat
nodes.plain_english: An AI consultant that answers questions about the supply chain by reading the Neo4j graph database.

nodes.name: Audit Memory Store
nodes.plain_english: Remembers past audits in-memory (simple material overlap matching) so the system can suggest similar ones.

nodes.name: Neo4j Database Layer
nodes.plain_english: Stores the supply chain as a graph of projects, materials, energy, and transport nodes connected by relationships.

nodes.name: OpenRouter AI
nodes.plain_english: Runs Owl-Alpha model to analyze supply chain documents and answer chat questions.

nodes.name: Serper.dev
nodes.plain_english: Google Search API that finds real emission factor data and source URLs for unknown materials.

nodes.name: Neo4j
nodes.plain_english: Cloud-hosted graph database that stores the supply chain data.

summary.headline: AI-powered supply chain carbon audit system — upload PDF invoices or BOMs, and it automatically identifies materials, calculates CO2e emissions, visualizes the supply chain as an interactive graph, and generates ISO 14067 reports.
